name: JellyXR
description: X-Ray style cast cards on pause (Android TV friendly).
overview: Scans videos once with on-server face recognition to learn which cast members appear when. Pause on Android TV and JellyXR sends text cards with the actors on screen (this scene) or the whole episode cast.
changelog: 1.7.0.0: Cast panel works with the JellyTvOverlay app (JellyXR TV is still supported this release); new actor detail with bio and titles in your library. 1.6.0.0: X-Ray items are no longer added to an "X-Ray" collection; the collection earlier versions created is deleted on the first marker sync (the next playback or the "Mark items with X-Ray data" task). The "X-Ray" tag and the optional genre stay.
